description.value:
Frequency once per round

You extend your shadow toward a foe within 15 feet that you can see. The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or be immobilized until the start of your next turn as your shadow tethers to theirs. On a successful save, the target is instead off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.
